tasks.prompt: Repair chunked(items, size). Consume a possibly one-pass iterable once and return a list of lists of at most size items, preserving order. Include the final partial chunk; empty input returns []. size must be a positive integer, otherwise raise ValueError. Modify only solution.py. Use only the Python standard library.

Repair stable_unique(items, key=None). Keep the first item for each distinct hashable key and preserve first-seen order. If key is omitted, each item itself is its key. Accept a one-pass iterable; return a new list without changing the input. Modify only solution.py. Use only the Python standard library.

Repair parse_query(query). Input is a URL query string without a leading question mark. Return a dict mapping decoded key strings to lists of decoded value strings, preserving value order. Decode percent escapes as UTF-8 and plus signs as spaces; preserve blank values and ignore empty ampersand segments. Empty input returns {}. Modify only solution.py. Use only the Python standard library.

Repair BoundedQueue(capacity). push(item) appends to a FIFO queue; when full, discard the oldest item before appending. pop() removes and returns the oldest item, raising IndexError when empty. len(queue) returns the current count. capacity must be a positive integer or raise ValueError. Falsey items are ordinary values. Modify only solution.py. Use only the Python standard library.

Repair weighted_average(samples), where each item is a (value, weight) pair of finite numbers. Return sum(value * weight) / sum(weight). Zero weights contribute nothing; reject a negative weight or zero total weight with ValueError. Accept a one-pass iterable without mutating inputs. Modify only solution.py. Use only the Python standard library.

Repair apply_edits(text, edits). Each edit is (start, end, replacement) with zero-based half-open offsets into the ORIGINAL string; edits arrive sorted by start and must not overlap. Return the edited string while preserving untouched characters. Reject an out-of-range or reversed span, or overlapping spans, with ValueError. An empty edit list returns text. Modify only solution.py. Use only the Python standard library.

Repair balanced_brackets(text). Return whether (), [], and {} brackets are properly nested and matched. Ignore every other character; empty text is balanced. A closing bracket without its matching opener returns False. Modify only solution.py. Use only the Python standard library.

Repair transpose_ragged(rows, fill=None). Return columns from a possibly one-pass iterable of row iterables. The result has as many columns as the longest row; every column has one entry per input row, using fill where a row is short. Preserve falsey values and None; empty rows return []. Do not change input rows. Modify only solution.py. Use only the Python standard library.
